policy_reason: Per Northstar policy, requests requiring delivery by a specific date must be escalated to a human agent so they can verify inventory and shipping options (AI may not promise expedited shipping).
recommended_action: Human agent should: 1) Confirm damage (review customer-provided photos or request them if not provided). 2) Check current inventory for product P-001 and available shipping methods and cutoff times. 3) Determine whether a replacement can be shipped in time for customer's deadline or offer a refund if not possible. 4) If replacement is possible, arrange shipment and notify the customer; if not, issue a refund per policy. 5) Update ticket with chosen resolution and shipping details. Include proposed timeline and any shipping cost approvals if expedited shipping is needed (escalate further per internal procedures).
